buyer_A_liability_tail.disclosed: Hardaway dispute $9,800 (disputed); customary warranty obligations, amount unspecified
buyer_A_liability_tail.effect: Buyer A assumes only listed trade payables, so these ride with the entity Ray liquidates and come out of company cash first. On the memo section 4 rollforward: a 9,800 payment out of company cash shrinks the liquidating distribution and the 160,000 liquidating capital gain one-for-one (ordinary income unchanged), recovering 9,800 x 20% = 1,960 of tax, a net cost of 7,840 - estimated net 2,192,260 - 7,840 = 2,184,420 if Hardaway is ultimately paid (conservative floor 2,182,460 if no tax offset is credited); warranty unquantified. Whether the payment itself is deductible as an ordinary loss is not addressed by the library - left open rather than forced (a few thousand dollars at most). Buyer B assumes all liabilities known and unknown, so stock_sale_buyer_b figures are unchanged; the Hardaway item is a known liability, so disclosure in the reps is required.
